about: Proposed region definition for a detailed map of Greater London, as one region. A proposal for discussion (docs/REGIONS-GB-LONDON.md); no code reads this file, and it does not ship.
how_checked: By an AI research agent reading publishers' pages through a fetch tool that returns an extract of each page. No person has yet opened each source again. Marks: opened, search only, not checked.

codes.not_iso: GB-LON is not an ISO 3166-2 code. ISO 3166-2:GB codes each London borough on its own and has no code for Greater London; GB-LND is the City of London only.
codes.why: Neither GB nor LON is an entry in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py).
codes.alternative: Use the ONS code as the id, or wait for a scheme for the whole United Kingdom. The nine ONS regions of England (E12000001 to E12000009) are one consistent level.
codes.verified: ONS codes opened (feature service). ISO list read from Wikipedia's copy, search only; the ISO site was not checked.

regions.name: London
regions.level: region of England (32 London boroughs and the City of London)

box_source.dataset: Regions (December 2024) Boundaries EN BFC, feature RGN24NM = 'London'
box_source.licence: OGL-UK-3.0; contains both Ordnance Survey and ONS intellectual property rights
box_source.caveat: Source data is in EPSG:27700 and the service did the conversion. If it converted the box corners and not every vertex, an edge can be off by a few thousandths of a degree. Recompute from the vertices before a build.

base_map_and_poi.verified: not checked (the site refuses automated reading); its taginfo instance was opened

terrain.dataset: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM), 1 m, resampled; OS Terrain 50 as fallback
terrain.verified: LIDAR: search only (platform page is a JavaScript app). OS Terrain 50: opened; 50 m post spacing, Great Britain, updated annually; the page says free to use and names no licence, OS's open data page gives OGL v3.
terrain.note: Both are bare-earth models. Copernicus GLO-30 is a surface model and would follow roofs in a city.

water.dataset: OS Open Rivers; OSM water areas, reservoirs and dams
water.verified: OS product list opened; OS Open Rivers' own page not opened
water.gap: No open inventory of dams or reservoirs was looked for.

crops.attribution: © Rural Payments Agency copyright and/or database right 2024. All rights reserved.
crops.gap: Class list (CROME_LUCODE_LOOKUP.XLSX) not read, so orchard, vineyard and berry classes are not confirmed.
crops.london_note: Allotments are the food-growing land inside London: 881 landuse=allotments in the OSM extract; OS Open Greenspace also lists allotments.

buildings.dataset: OSM buildings or Overture buildings; OS OpenMap - Local as a cross-check
buildings.verified: OS product list opened; coverage not measured; Microsoft footprints for the UK not checked

datasets.contents: more than 870,000 roads, nearly 44,000 settlements, more than 1.6 million postcodes (Great Britain); quarterly
about 1.7 million current postcode units (Great Britain); quarterly
datasets.attribution_extra: Royal Mail and National Statistics lines are also asked for (search only)
datasets.verified: opened 2026-11-17; the page names no licence, OS's open data page gives OGL v3

addresses.gap: No open source for full addresses in Great Britain. Overture's address theme (release 2026-10-21.0, 41 countries) has no GB rows. OS Open UPRN holds only UPRN, X_COORDINATE, Y_COORDINATE, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE.
addresses.proposed_instead: Postcode points (Code-Point Open) and street names (OS Open Names); exact houses only from OSM addr:* tags.

help_points.caveat: Read through a tool that reformats the service's answer. The extract's clipping line was not read, so counts may include places just outside the boundary.

official_lists.caveat: 1,398 stations as of July 2020; London rows not counted. A cross-check, not a source.

official_lists.dataset: NHS website datasets (hospitals, GPs, pharmacies, dentists)
official_lists.caveat: Available on request by email or through a feed that needs a developer account. Not proposed.
No licence stated on the page. Not yet usable.

for_decision.attribution: © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2025. All rights reserved.
for_decision.note: Fixed areas fit an offline map; live warnings do not. A new kind of layer, so a question, not a proposal.
